visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair and bangs, wearing a black top and a silver necklace, holds a white box with colorful cartoon character illustrations towards the camera. The setting is an indoor room with warm, bright lighting and various items visible on a shelf in the background. (2) She moves the box closer to the lens, showing the detailed 'CanKing' branding and series title. (3) The scene cuts to a top-down view of six small blind boxes packed inside the larger container. (4) She holds up a single small box and a transparent plastic-wrapped package. (5) She displays a small business card with a maid character illustration and the words 'Coffee Shop CanKing'. (6) She unfolds a long character introduction sheet, showing various anime-style characters and descriptions. (7) A close-up of an acrylic stand with a male character and a blue spinning wheel labeled with food items like 'Sushi' and 'Salmon'. (8) A sequence of cuts showcases different themed stands: a red Chinese restaurant theme, a green matcha tea shop theme, a black yakiniku grill theme, a yellow izakaya theme, and a dark-toned maid cafe theme. (9) The video concludes with a collage of all the acrylic stands and on-screen graphics for the 'CanKing Store'.
